best_rules_serialized.name: academic_suffix_name

best_rules_serialized.name: preposition_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names with prepositions like 'auf der', 'von der', 'zu der' which are common in German names (e.g., 'Renata auf der Heyde'). Fixed to capture only the name.

best_rules_serialized.name: born_context_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following 'geboren am' (born on) which is a common pattern for identifying individuals.

best_rules_serialized.name: accused_context_name

best_rules_serialized.name: verb_context_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following verbs like 'ist', 'wurde', 'lebte' which often precede person names in legal texts, specifically for cases like 'lebte mit Ernst Schoenekaess'. Excludes common professions and abstract nouns.

best_rules_serialized.name: senatspraesident_name

best_rules_serialized.name: witness_context_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following 'Zeuge', 'Zeugin', 'Zeugen' (witness) to identify witnesses in legal texts.

best_rules_serialized.name: accusative_genitive_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures person names following legal role terms in accusative or genitive cases (e.g., 'des Angeklagten', 'der Zehra Dreissig') to identify defendants, witnesses, etc., without titles.

best_rules_serialized.name: mj_minor_name

best_rules_serialized.name: anonymous_person_dr
